text.description: One claim, in a sentence or two of plain prose.

basis.description: paper: the paper itself says this, and `evidence` quotes it. dossier: a record in the neighbour dossier supports it, and `work_ids` names the record. background: your own knowledge of the field; the reader sees it labelled unverified.

quote.description: Copied exactly from the page text, 8 to 300 characters.

items.description: A verbatim passage from the paper and the page it is on.

evidence.description: For a paper claim: one or two verbatim quotes that state it. Empty for other claims.

work_ids.description: For a dossier claim: the ids of the dossier records that support it, exactly as given. Empty for other claims.

before.description: The state of the question before the paper: the specific prior results, methods and debates it entered.

after.description: What happened after: who built on it, who disputed it, how it is used now. Empty when you do not know.

reception_note.description: When you do not know how the paper was received, say so here in one sentence (for example that it is too recent); otherwise null.

work_id.description: The dossier id of the work, exactly as given; null when the work is not in the dossier.

title.description: The work's exact title. If you know the work but not its exact title, give the authors and year and describe it in `why` instead of guessing.

authors.description: Short author string, e.g. 'Card' or 'Vaswani et al.'.

relation.description: predecessor: came before and this paper builds on or answers it. successor: came after and builds on this paper. critique: disputes this paper, or this paper disputes it. replication: reruns or re-tests the result. survey: an overview or textbook treatment of the question. parallel: independent work on the same question at about the same time.

why.description: One line on what the reader gets from reading it next to this paper.

basis.description: dossier: the work is in the dossier and `work_id` is set. background: you know the work yourself; `work_id` is null. paper: the paper itself cites it.

read_alongside.description: Up to six neighbouring works worth reading next to this one; only works you could cite accurately. Two right works beat five with one invented.

lead.description: Written last: two to four sentences that distil before, contribution and after for a reader from another field. Say what changed, or, when reception is unknown, what the paper attempts that its predecessors did not.

description: Why this paper matters: before, contribution, after, and what to read alongside it.
